name: discover is acknowledged
notes: v2 sends discover to the Discovery Service, not the PN (beckn.yaml:131, Communication_Protocol.md:131). Signed per docs/Authentication_and_Trust.md 4; context.bapId/bapUri/networkId/messageId are templated by the runner. Response must echo messageId (beckn.yaml Ack) and carry the signed Signature header (beckn.yaml AckSignatureHeader, required). 202 AckNoCallback (no results) is also conformant, handled below.
